title: Xenon difluoride in three dimensions
hook: Turn a model of XeF₂ and examine its shape.

knows: Atoms or cells can be represented with simplified models.
doesNotKnow: Five electron regions surround xenon, including three lone pairs. The two bonded fluorine atoms occupy opposite positions, so the molecular structure is linear.

misconception: A familiar diagram automatically reveals the structure or function.
objective: Five electron regions surround xenon, including three lone pairs. The two bonded fluorine atoms occupy opposite positions, so the molecular structure is linear.
